regime_context: As of 2026-07-24, the US thematic detector shows a broad rotation with Memory/HBM leading (rank 1) but fading (durability 0.46, mixed Hurst). Cybersecurity (rank 2) holds a durable trend but is crowded. Several value/cyclical themes (Energy, Financials) display strong trend health and broad participation. The absolute-trend gate remains the only validated edge, primarily helping to control drawdowns. Track record (7 calls, 29% directional accuracy) suggests low conviction is warranted.
emerging_watch: Cybersecurity’s challenge to Memory/HBM leadership: If the margin (currently 2.736) narrows to below 0.5 and Cybersecurity’s durability_bar stays above 0.8 while Memory’s score continues to fade, a confirmed handoff could emerge. Kill-criterion: Memory/HBM’s durability_bar rises above 0.6 and its score stabilizes, or Cybersecurity’s breadth drops below 0.5.
